stories.title: The Man in the Ant-Hill / Ant-Man’s first costume
stories.why: Hank Pym’s original beginning: the scientist first, then the costumed hero.
stories.match: No confirmed collection match for these original issues. Season One is a later retelling, not these 1962 stories.

stories.title: Scott Lang’s debut
stories.why: The foundation of Scott’s story and his relationship with Cassie.
stories.match: Ant-Man No More includes Marvel Premiere #47–48 among other Hank Pym and related stories. It overlaps the dedicated Scott Lang anthology.

stories.title: The Irredeemable Ant-Man
stories.why: An intentionally unlikeable new Ant-Man: Eric O’Grady.
stories.match: Read Low-Life (#1–6), then Small-Minded (#7–12). This is Eric, not Scott or Hank.

stories.title: Second-Chance Man
stories.why: Nick Spencer’s Scott Lang run is a practical modern starting point.
stories.match: Continue with The Astonishing Ant-Man; its Vol. 1 is a later relaunch, not this same first book.

stories.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Lost and Found
stories.why: A short team-up pairing Scott Lang with Nadia van Dyne.
stories.match: Nadia is the Wasp here, not Janet. The Saga of Scott Lang collection overlaps this story.

stories.title: World Hive
stories.why: A short Scott-and-Cassie adventure recommended by readers.
stories.match: Matched by exact ISBN and collection title in the supplied catalog. Open the library record to check borrowing.

stories.title: Ant-Iversary
stories.why: A compact tour of multiple Ant-Men and their different eras.
stories.match: The volume includes older bonus stories; the main four-issue anniversary story was published in 2022.
